study.research_question: Does the Score-S harness admit both selectors on frozen controlled pools and on one natural pool generated once with delegate_task(best_of=4)?
study.research_gap: Earlier cohorts used label-only verdicts, three authored tasks and serial arms; calibration, reliability and load-matched comparison were not measured.
study.hypothesis: 18 selector outputs are admissible; the observed Score expected-level deviation fixes the preregistered tolerance.

primary_metric.name: score_admission_valid_selection_ratio
primary_metric.aggregation: valid selector outputs / 18 planned (2 controlled pools x 2 orders x 3 selectors + 1 natural pool x 2 orders x 3 selectors)

study.decision_rule: Admission only. Runs with score_tolerance=0.05; then freeze the Score expected-level tolerance = min(0.05, max(0.03, observed max deviation rounded up to 0.01)) in score-tolerance-freeze.json. Record natural-pool discriminativeness; above 70% non-discriminative makes U5 descriptive only.
study.invalidation_rule: Judgment-output invalid (schema, label, non-finite probability, Choice sum beyond 0.025, verdict not an argmax label, refusal, unexpected stop reason) is a valid attempt with a wrong answer: it stays in accuracy denominators and is excluded from probability metrics. Infrastructure invalid (no response, timeout, missing capture or receipt, harness error, quota exhaustion) is validity=invalid, outcome=unknown. Preregistered panel exception: a transport failure without any response is kept as an unselected invalid attempt and replaced exactly once by a child attempt on the same input; a failed replacement stays selected, makes the primary not measurable and stops the unit; replacements above 2% of planned calls stop the unit. Quota exhaustion, harness errors and route violations (non-subscription Astra, model, effort or provider drift, global Jev) are selected invalid attempts and stop the unit. Pin #2 (0028): non-quota HTTP 429 is rate_limited; wait Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date, default 30 s, clipped to 0-120 s) then exactly one replacement under the same 2% ceiling. retry_wait_s is excluded from measured latency. quota, billing, usage_limit, usage_not_included and plan_limit codes, HTTP 402 and BillingError are quota_exhausted: stop without replacement.
